lead: Bought bread, bakery goods, biscuits, chocolate, sweets, savoury snacks, snack bars and ice cream, organised by product kind, then named styles, makers and quality grades; dishes and recipes live in the Culinary Taxonomy.

depts.note: Bought bread and baked goods as products; home recipes belong to the Culinary Taxonomy.

b.w: Real Bread Campaign definitions; artisan baking guides
EU PDO/PGI/TSG registers (e.g. Pane di Altamura, Aachener Printen)

s.brief: Archetypes are named national breads (baguette, sourdough San Francisco, pumpernickel, Vollkornbrot, ciabatta, focaccia, bagel styles, pita, naan, tortilla). Record protected names (PDO/PGI/TSG) and the originating region; no recipes. Supermarket sliced-bread brands only as a short tier list in m.

Viennoiserie, festive breads and bought cakes as products. Archetypes: croissant, pain au chocolat, Danish, kouign-amann, panettone (Milanese makers), pandoro, stollen (Dresdner Christstollen PGI), Lebkuchen, fruitcake, Baumkuchen, castella, mooncake. Note festive-season use.

depts.note: Tier for everyday packs; variety for named heritage biscuits.

s.brief: Archetypes are named biscuit styles with originators: digestive (McVitie's), Rich Tea, shortbread (Walkers), Oreo, Speculoos (Lotus), Bourbon, custard cream, Jaffa Cake, Garibaldi, Petit Beurre (LU), amaretti, biscotti/cantucci, stroopwafel, Tim Tam, chocolate chip cookie. Order by significance.

Water biscuit (Carr's, Jacob's), cream cracker, oatcakes (Nairn's), Ritz, saltine, Scandinavian crispbread (Wasa, Ryvita), rice cakes, grissini, matzo, Swedish knäckebröd. Cheese-board crackers as products.

depts.note: Craft chocolate is organised origin → maker → cocoa percentage.

b.w: EU Directive 2000/36/EC minimum cocoa solids; maker labelling
Academy of Chocolate and International Chocolate Awards categories

s.brief: Craft side: origins (Madagascar Sambirano, Venezuela Chuao, Ecuador Arriba Nacional, Peru, Ghana) → makers (Valrhona, Amedei, Domori, Michel Cluizel, Pralus, Bonnat, Marou, Dandelion, Mast, Original Beans, Pump Street) → % versions. Mass-market side: tier list (Lindt, Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, Hershey's, Ritter Sport, Tony's Chocolonely, Green & Black's). Record award bodies.

Belgian pralines (Neuhaus originator 1912, Godiva, Leonidas, Pierre Marcolini), French ganache bonbons (La Maison du Chocolat, Patrick Roger), Swiss truffles (Sprüngli), Mozartkugel (Fürst), countlines (Mars, Snickers, Kit Kat, Toblerone), seasonal moulded figures (Easter egg, chocolate Santa, Advent calendar).

k.brief: only solid chocolate products; cocoa powder stays in J6

depts.note: Sugar sweets and national confectionery traditions; add tradition-register entries.

b.w: EU PGI/TSG (Turrón de Jijona, Calissons d'Aix), Japan wagashi guilds, Indian mithai houses

s.brief: Hard candy & lollipop (Chupa Chups), toffee & caramel (Werther's), fudge, gummies (Haribo Goldbären originator), liquorice (Dutch drop, Haribo, Panda), marshmallow, jelly beans (Jelly Belly), mints (Altoids, Fisherman's Friend, Pastilles), chewing gum (Wrigley's), rock (seaside rock), boiled sweets, sherbet. Brands into register.

Each kind gets a tradition entry: Turkish delight (Hacı Bekir 1777), halva, nougat & turrón (Jijona, Montélimar), marzipan (Lübeck Niederegger, Toledo), wagashi (yokan, mochi, higashi), Indian mithai (barfi, ladoo, soan papdi), dragées & sugared almonds (Sulmona confetti), calisson, brigadeiro, dulce de leche sweets, candied fruit & marrons glacés, baklava as boxed confection.

depts.note: Tier for mainstream brands; variety for kettle and regional snack styles.

b.w: pack labelling; Which? and taste tests

s.brief: Potato crisps (Walkers, Lay's, Pringles, Tyrrells, Kettle, Torres), tortilla chips, extruded corn snacks (Cheetos, Wotsits, Monster Munch), popcorn, pretzels (Bavarian Laugenbrezel; snack pretzels), pork scratchings & chicharrón, prawn crackers, rice crackers (senbei, Japanese snacks e.g. Calbee), seaweed snacks, Bombay mix & namkeen (Haldiram's), vegetable crisps.

depts.note: Quality-of-life snacks; brands covering the market plus independent test winners.

b.w: nutrition labelling; Which?/CHOICE snack bar tests

s.brief: Keep Protein bar (Quest, Grenade, Barebells, Fulfil, ONE, Pure Protein) and Protein snack (protein chips, cookies) moved in from H2. Add roasted & salted nuts (KP, Planters, Blue Diamond), coated nuts, trail mix, seed snacks, cereal/granola bars (Nature Valley, Kellogg's), energy & sports bars (Clif, PowerBar), fruit & nut bars (Nakd, KIND, Larabar), rice-crispy bars. Trim SKU noise.

depts.note: Tier for supermarket tubs; variety for gelato and world frozen-dessert styles.

b.v: frozen confection · ice cream · dairy ice cream · premium/super-premium (low overrun)
b.w: UK Ice Cream Regulations; US FDA standard of identity; industry overrun grading

s.brief: Tubs (Ben & Jerry's, Häagen-Dazs, Carte d'Or, Breyers, Jeni's), gelato (Italian styles; Grom), sorbet, frozen yogurt, kulfi, mochi ice cream, ice lolly & popsicle, choc ice & stick bars (Magnum, Cornetto as cone), ice cream sandwich, ice cream cake, dairy-free ice cream. Frozen confections as bought products only.
